answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in vertex and umber lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the spiral graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1953 impostors cost 535 times the honest price and take 10 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
